mentions.name: npmdigest
mentions.description: A micro-SaaS that digests npm's 'Successfully published X' emails, sparing package authors from notification spam when releasing new versions of their packages.
mentions.problem: Getting spammed by npm emails saying 'Successfully published X' whenever releasing new versions of packages.
mentions.source_excerpt: Yesterday I released https://npmdigest.com, a micro-SaaS to work around the frustrating experience of getting spammed by npm emails "Successfully published X" whenever I release new versions of my packages.
